<security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD's top-level scope contains only standard variable assignments (pkgname, pkgver, depends, source, sha256sums, etc.) and function definitions for prepare(), build(), and package(). There are no command substitutions, network requests, eval/base64 usage, or file operations at the top level that could execute malicious code during sourcing. The source URL points to the package's own upstream (archive.mozilla.org), which is expected behavior.
</details>

<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD follows standard Arch packaging practices. It downloads the declared Mozilla VPN source archive from the official Mozilla archive, verifies it with a fixed SHA-256 checksum, extracts it, and builds and installs it using CMake. The installation of Mozilla VPN's polkit rules and the listed runtime dependencies support the application's stated functionality.

The file contains no suspicious network requests, credential or filesystem-data collection, obfuscated commands, or execution of externally downloaded scripts. No malicious or dangerous behavior was identified.</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>Standard Mozilla VPN packaging with verified upstream source and no malicious behavior.</summary>
